name: Chellah
subtitle: Ancient archaeological site of Roman Sala Colonia transformed in the 14th century into a fortified Marinid royal necropolis.

facts.label: Antiquity
facts.value: Phoenician trading post and Roman Sala Colonia

parts.text: A medieval walled archaeological complex perched on the south bank of the Bou Regreg. It encloses the excavated forum, triumphal arch and thermal baths of Roman Sala Colonia, alongside a 14th-century Marinid royal necropolis with a zellij-adorned minaret, madrasa, and the tombs of Sultan Abu al-Hasan and his wife Shams al-Duha, famous today for its peaceful gardens and colonies of nesting storks.

gaps: Comprehensive epigraphic records from the Roman Mauretanian transition are preserved in Rabat archaeological museums and should be consulted.
